title: On $(1,2^4)$ and $(1,2^5)$-packing edge-coloring of sparse subcubic graphs
summary: A $(1^j,2^k)$-packing edge-coloring of a graph $G$ is a partition of the edge set $E(G)$ into $j$ matchings and $k$ induced matchings. Hocquard, Lajou, and Lu\v zar found a subcubic planar graph of girth $3$ that has no $(1,2^5)$-packing edge-coloring and also conjectured that every subcubic planar graph has a $(1,2^6)$-packing edge-coloring. We also notice that for every fixed positive integer $k$ there exists a subcubic planar graph with girth $k$ that is not $(1,2^3)$-packing edge-colorable.
